intro: Madagascar has about 31 million people, mostly young and rural.

chapters.title: People
text: Malagasy and French are official. The Merina live in the highlands; there are around 18 main groups. Many people follow Christianity along with respect for ancestors.

chapters.title: Antananarivo
text: Antananarivo, or 'Tana', is the capital, built on hills.

keyTerms.meaning: A ceremony of rewrapping ancestors' remains.
